title: How the test works + free test reminder
caption:
How does a test know you're a Mezbaan? Here's the honest answer.

The personality test has 48 questions and takes about 8 minutes, in English or Urdu. Each answer nudges you along four scales, and you see percentages, not just letters. The Asli Mizaj quiz adds your temperament in 4 more minutes. All three tests are free.

One tip: answer like your ordinary Tuesday self, not your CV self.

Taken it yet? Comment your result.

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
